name: MAIN heap 1024 MiB
note: 3 Sep 2026: grow the SPRJ MAIN heap (profile row 1, table at 0x4736d40 + row*0x80; entry 0) from 0x20c00000 (524 MiB) to 0x40000000 (1024 MiB). Talk ESDs (EsdResCap) allocate from MAIN via the global at 0x5540408, so this tests whether the Enhanced mod's 12-18x larger talk scripts fail to allocate silently. Direct memory budget: 4608 + extra_dmem 4096 MiB; the other heaps sum to ~7404 MiB, so 1024 fits.
